 The Honourable Sri Justice K.Surender
 Criminal Petition No.3963 Of 2023
Order:

entities.text: Thudi Meghareddy vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioner- accused to quash the proceedings against him in respect of FIR No.58 of 2023 pending on the file of Station House Officer, Wanaparthy Town Police Station, Wanaparthy District, filed for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 406 and 506 of Indian Penal Code (for short "IPC").
2.

entities.text: Wanaparthy Town Police Station, Wanaparthy District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent - State.
3. The 2nd respondent - de facto complainant filed a complaint alleging that this petitioner who owed money did not pay the said amount in a railway contract work.
4. The learned Senior Counsel appearing for the petitioner would submit that according to the complaint, Rs.10,00,000/- was paid by the petitioner to the 2nd respondent.
However, the bank statement would reflect that this petitioner had paid an amount of Rs.32,00,000/-.
The 2nd respondent filed the present complaint by suppressing the said fact.
5. To attract an offence of cheating punishable under Section 420 of IPC, there should have been an intention since the inception.
Even assuming that Rs.10,00,000/- was paid at the initial stage, the question of attracting an offence under Section 420 of IPC does not arise.

6. Since the transactions appear to be civil in nature, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the Investigating Officer in respect of FIR No.58 of 2023 of Wanaparthy Town Police Station,
Wanaparthy District, to conclude investigation without taking any coercive steps against the petitioner - accused, by considering the statement of accounts and explanation submitted by the petitioner.

entities.text:
Wanaparthy Town Police Station,
Wanaparthy District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Further, the petitioner shall appear before the police and execute a personal bond for an amount of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) and shall co-operate with the Investigating Officer as and when required for the purpose of investigation.
7. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
